verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a headless Sync client that syncs vaults without the desktop app and is explicitly positioned for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows. Because vaults are plain Markdown files on disk, CI jobs can also read and write notes directly. However, the headless capability covers only syncing: the evidence shows no headless mode for the app itself, and Obsidian URI triggers assume a running app. Missing for 10: a headless/CLI mode for core app features (plugins, Bases, Publish), detailed docs on headless Sync setup and auth, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
